'''Eamus 6''' was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Eamus system/Legends|Eamus system]], a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It had at least one [[Star/Legends|sun]], and occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] caused devastating [[Groundquake/Legends|quakes]] on Eamus 6. In response, the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Eamus 6 on her [[CR90 corvette/Legends|consular starship]], the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], on a well-publicized mercy mission to bring emergency gear and [[Medic/Legends|medical]] supplies to the celestial body's population.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eamus 6 was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the astronomical object in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
